tasks.notes:
# Task #61 — install.sh: drop the ralph compatibility symlink

## Outcome

`install.sh` no longer creates a `ralph` symlink; only `cairn` is installed.
TDD followed: updated the test first, confirmed it failed against the old
script, then edited `install.sh` to make it pass.

## Changes

1. **`install.sh`**:
   - Header comment (lines 4-8) rewritten to describe only the cairn
     symlink — dropped the "Both `cairn` and `ralph` are symlinked..." prose
     and the `remove once all projects migrated` marker (the marker is gone
     because the fallback it described no longer exists).
   - Deleted `ln -sf "$CAIRN_BIN" "$PREFIX/bin/ralph"  # remove once all projects migrated`.
   - Deleted `echo "Installed: $PREFIX/bin/ralph -> $CAIRN_BIN"`.
   - Left untouched exactly as instructed: `bun run build`, `CAIRN_BIN="$CAIRN_ROOT/dist/cairn"`,
     the `dist/cairn` existence check, and the PATH-check block.

2. **`test/install-script.test.ts`**:
   - Replaced `'symlinks both cairn and ralph to the built binary'` with
     `'symlinks cairn to the built binary'` (cairn-only assertion) plus a new
     `'does not create a ralph symlink'` test asserting `$PREFIX/bin/ralph`
     no longer appears in the script.
   - Deleted `'does not print a deprecation warning for the ralph symlink'`
     (no longer meaningful — there's no ralph symlink to warn about).
   - Kept `'uses CAIRN_ROOT/CAIRN_BIN local shell vars, not RALPH_ROOT/RALPH_BIN'`
     unchanged, and kept the `package.json` describe block's
     `dist/ralph` negative assertion unchanged.

## Verification

- `bun test test/install-script.test.ts` before the install.sh edit → 5 pass,
  1 fail (the new "does not create a ralph symlink" test, as expected under
  TDD).
- `bun test test/install-script.test.ts` after the edit → **6 pass, 0 fail**.
- `bun test test/legacy-markers.test.ts` → 5 pass — removing the marker
  along with its now-deleted fallback line doesn't trip the enforcement
  suite (there's nothing left to flag).
- `grep -n "ralph" install.sh` → no matches. `grep -n "remove once all
  projects migrated" install.sh` → no matches (expected: the fallback and
  its marker were deleted together).
- `bun test` (full suite) → **811 pass, 0 fail, 30 files** (same total as
  before — 2 tests removed, 2 added, net zero).
- Did **not** run `./install.sh`, touch `package.json`'s build script,
  `CAIRN_BIN`, or `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` — binary stays pinned per the
  round's freeze procedure.

## Notes for future tasks / manual step

- This does **not** remove the existing `~/.local/bin/ralph` symlink already
  on disk from prior installs — per the task description, that's a manual
  post-round step the user performs themselves (re-running `./install.sh`
  now would only ever create/refresh `$PREFIX/bin/cairn`; the old
  `~/.local/bin/ralph` symlink, if present, is simply orphaned until removed
  by hand).
- No discovered tasks this iteration — task matched the codebase exactly,
  scope was small and self-contained.

tasks.description: Delete test/legacy-markers.test.ts. It exists to guarantee every legacy fallback carries the 'remove once all projects migrated' marker so this removal round could be mechanical; with every fallback now gone it has nothing left to enforce. BEFORE deleting, run `grep -rn "remove once all projects migrated" src/ lib/ install.sh` and confirm the only remaining hits are in src/brand.ts (the LEGACY object, handled by task 63). If any other file still carries a marker, STOP and report rather than deleting — that means an earlier task left work behind. This task is deliberately ordered BEFORE the src/brand.ts task, inverting what the planning notes originally said. The reason: deleting LEGACY forces a hardcoded '.ralph_' literal for the permanent .ralph_task_<id>_notes.md scratch exception, and this test fails on that unmarked mention — which would leave task 63 with a red suite and get it reverted to in-progress by the post-iteration validator. Tasks 51-61 only REMOVE marked mentions and can never introduce an unmarked one, so the guardrail has no remaining work. Do NOT modify cairn.json's healthCheck and do NOT run ./install.sh. Do not touch .cairn/tasks.completed.json, .cairn_iterations.log, .cairn_tasks_snapshot.json, .cairn/reviews/round-*.md, .ralph_task_*_notes.md, or audit/.

tasks.title: Decide the fate of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain — no production callers remain
tasks.description: Task #51 deleted warnIfLegacyApiKey and its two call sites (src/commands/narrate.ts, src/commands/run.ts), which were the only consumers of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain(). The function is still exported from src/config.ts and covered by test/config.test.ts, but nothing in src/ calls it — the resolution is now purely documentary, mirroring the same chain in lib/cairn_narrate_server.py (see task #59). Either (a) delete the helper, its AnthropicApiKeyResolution type, and its tests, leaving the Python server as the single implementation, or (b) keep it and give it a real caller — e.g. have runNarrate/runRun pass the resolved key into the narration server env instead of relying on the child process re-reading the environment. Do NOT normalize onto plain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY under either option: the loop deliberately blanks that name to force Max-plan usage. Sequence this after #59 so both sides of the mirror are decided together.
